### Niagen Bioscience to Present at Canaccord Genuity’s Well Summit


September 10, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/770776702/files/doc_news/Niagen-Bioscience-to-Present-at-Canaccord-Genuitys-Well-Summit-2026.pdf)


LOS ANGELES--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Niagen Bioscience, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenbioscience.com%2F&esheet=54601180&newsitemid=20260910242293&lan=en-US&anchor=Niagen+Bioscience%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=c68b34f8b113a2bfd6dba2be66eefa7c) (NASDAQ: NAGE), the global authority on NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) with a focus on the science of healthy aging, today announced that its Chief Executive Officer, Rob Fried, and Chief Financial Officer, Ozan Pamir, will participate in[Canaccord Genuity’s Well Summit](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.canaccordgenuity.com%2Fcapital-markets%2Fevents-and-conferences%2F2026-cg-well-summit%2F&esheet=54601180&newsitemid=20260910242293&lan=en-US&anchor=Canaccord+Genuity%26%238217%3Bs+Well+Summit&index=2&md5=9a633ab8e4ac64906151f3d9a3a03926) , taking place from September 28 to 30, 2026, in New York.


Mr. Fried is scheduled to participate in the Aging on Trial: Peptides, Hormones, and the Line Between Breakthrough and Hype Panel on Tuesday, September 29, from 11:15 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. ET at The Plaza in New York.


Canaccord Genuity’s Well Summit returns for its second year, offering top executives, investors, and innovators shaping the Consumer Health & Wellness sector a unique opportunity to connect and engage.


A replay of the panel webcast will be available on the Niagen Bioscience Investor Relations website,[www.investors.niagenbioscience.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.niagenbioscience.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54601180&newsitemid=20260910242293&lan=en-US&anchor=www.investors.niagenbioscience.com&index=3&md5=0a4c3ba32f54f9c7ff5fa4538994e463) , following the event.


For additional information on Niagen Bioscience, visit[www.niagenbioscience.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenbioscience.com&esheet=54601180&newsitemid=20260910242293&lan=en-US&anchor=www.niagenbioscience.com&index=4&md5=cba61f6ac86a1dde98e43306114271d6) .


**About Niagen Bioscience**


[Niagen Bioscience, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenbioscience.com%2F&esheet=54601180&newsitemid=20260910242293&lan=en-US&anchor=Niagen+Bioscience%2C+Inc.&index=5&md5=9b3a91932ee6b24a7d96950da2a14783) (NASDAQ: NAGE) is the global authority in healthy aging and NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) science. As a trusted pioneer of NAD+ discoveries, Niagen Bioscience™ is dedicated to advancing healthspan through precision science and innovative NAD+-boosting solutions.


The Niagen Bioscience team, composed of world-renowned scientists, works with independent investigators from esteemed universities and research institutions around the globe to uncover the full potential of NAD+. A vital coenzyme found in every cell of the human body, NAD+ declines with age and exposure to everyday lifestyle stressors. NAD+ depletion is a key contributor to age-related changes in health and vitality.


Distinguished by state-of-the-art laboratories, rigorous scientific and quality protocols, and collaborations with leading research institutions worldwide, Niagen Bioscience sets the gold standard for research, quality, and innovation. There’s a better way to age.


At the heart of its clinically tested product portfolio is Niagen® (patented nicotinamide riboside, or NR), the most efficient, well-researched, and high-quality NAD+ booster available. Niagen powers the Company’s consumer supplement, Tru Niagen®, the number one NAD+ boosting oral supplement in the United States† (available at[www.truniagen.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.truniagen.com&esheet=54601180&newsitemid=20260910242293&lan=en-US&anchor=www.truniagen.com&index=6&md5=bc0e71b9aa1d3554dd6db8ad59eb95a6) ), and Niagen™ Plus, featuring pharmaceutical-grade intravenous (IV) and injectable Niagen products ([www.niagenplus.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenplus.com&esheet=54601180&newsitemid=20260910242293&lan=en-US&anchor=www.niagenplus.com&index=7&md5=071f82c458bb324d246618d5805515b1) ). Pharmaceutical-grade Niagen IV and injections are compounded and distributed by U.S. FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facilities and are available exclusively at clinics with a prescription. NAD Pharmaceuticals Corp., the Company’s wholly owned subsidiary focused on developing therapies for accelerated aging and rare genetic diseases, is conducting research on NB4168, a differentiated small molecule.


Niagen Bioscience’s robust patent portfolio protects NR and other NAD+ precursors. Niagen Bioscience maintains a website at[www.niagenbioscience.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenbioscience.com&esheet=54601180&newsitemid=20260910242293&lan=en-US&anchor=www.niagenbioscience.com&index=8&md5=2b3aaa3cae0d3c9b1135cccb6468b19a) , where copies of press releases, news, and financial information are regularly published.
